name: JW Marriott Dongdaemun Square
positioning: JW Marriott Dongdaemun Square Seoul: the first JW Marriott in South Korea, standing opposite the historic Heunginjimun Gate in the Dongdaemun district
best_for: Travelers who want views of Heunginjimun Gate and a base near DDP, Myeongdong and the Dongdaemun shopping district
Spa-goers drawn to Provence Spa by L'OCCITANE and a heated indoor pool
Guests who want Executive Lounge access with Sky View rooms

facts.text: The hotel stands opposite the historic Heunginjimun Gate, also called the East Gate.
The hotel is near DDP, Myeongdong, high-end shopping, entertainment and attractions.
Dongdaemun is home to one of Seoul's biggest shopping districts.
The hotel is the first JW Marriott property in South Korea.
The lobby has a sparkling acrylic and nylon thread installation by Korean artist Bahk Seon Ghi suspended from the ceiling.
Rooms offer views of Heunginjimun Gate, the hotel's garden or the Dongdaemun district.
Every room has a marble bathroom.
Executive Sky View rooms include Executive Lounge access with complimentary breakfasts, cocktails and snacks.
The hotel has a heated indoor pool and a spa.
Club Griffin was Korea's first fitness club with eco-friendly LEED Gold certification.
Tavolo 24 is an all-day dining restaurant offering Korean BBQ and international dishes, with panoramic views of Heunginjimun Gate and the Seoul Fortress Wall.
The Griffin is a rooftop bar with views of Heunginjimun Gate and Cheonggyecheon Stream, and live jazz on select evenings.

highlights.text: The hotel stands opposite the historic Heunginjimun Gate, also called the East Gate.
The hotel was the first hotel in South Korea to earn the LEED Gold rating.
In the Executive Sky View Room the windows begin at the ceiling, skylight-style, and extend down the wall.
The spa is Provence Spa by L'OCCITANE, offering healing and beauty treatments.
The hotel has an indoor screen golf range with advanced sensors.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 19.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with high foot traffic in the surrounding area.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing typical of luxury international hotel chains.
